key_insight: OmniQEC uses an LLM-driven, self-improving search loop to discover quantum error-correcting codes that are not just theoretically good, but practical under hardware, syndrome-extraction, and decoding constraints.
engineering_relevance: The work points to a scalable, AI-assisted workflow for co-designing QEC codes and circuits that better fit near-term quantum processors.
method: LLM orchestrator generates and refines QEC candidates
Fast loop screens codes with inexpensive proxies; slow loop evaluates full circuit-level performance
Physical-qubit and decoder feedback is recycled into the search process
evidence_signal: Across four qLDPC families, three LLM backends, and 14 physical-qubit budgets, the discovered codes improved with larger budgets and outperformed BB codes at 98- and 240-qubit complete-implementation budgets.
watch_item: Results depend on the chosen proxy metrics, syndrome-extraction synthesis, and decoder quality, so transfer to different hardware stacks may require re-optimization.
paper_title: OmniQEC: discovering practical quantum error-correcting codes by an AI scientist
